name: Sound Modes
description:
Save a complete audio setup as a mode and switch it in one click from Quick Settings.

A mode combines an output device, an input device, a Bluetooth profile or codec, EasyEffects presets and call-only routing. Devices are discovered automatically and matched on stable properties, so modes survive reconnects, replugs and suspend. PipeWire and WirePlumber are required; EasyEffects is optional.
